statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack.
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion events.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances during symptom onset.
The service supports the diagnosis of G45.9.
The results are expected to identify intermittent arrhythmias that would guide further management.
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204.
